title: ALBU-CHIP - Efficacy of human 20% albumin solution + Ringer Lactate versus Ringer Lactate for fluid replacement strategy during cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy : a randomized clinical trial
official: ALBU-CHIP - Efficacy of human 20% albumin solution + Ringer Lactate versus Ringer Lactate for fluid replacement strategy during cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy : a randomized clinical trial
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of 20% albumin combined with Ringer Lactate versus Ringer Lactate for fluid therapy during CRS with HIPEC on post operative outcome at 28 day.
conditions: Cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy
Neoplasms benign malignant and unspecified (incl cysts and polyps)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 18 years old and older
2. Planned cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC for peritoneal carcinomatosis (from gynaecological or digestive origin)
3. Patient volunteer for the study and provided written informed consent
4. Patient affiliated to the French Health Insurance
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pre-operative disease influencing plasmatic albumin levels (hepatic cirrhosis, nephrotic syndrome, exudative enteropathy, severe denutrition)
2. Hyperkaliemia > 6.0 mmol/L
3. Hypercalcemia > 2.60 mmol/L
4. Chronic use of digitalis and hyperkalemic diuretics
5. Pregnancy, Breast feeding
6. Aged > 75 years old
7. Functional status making the patient ineligible for cytoreduction with CHIP (ECOG > 2 or Karnofsky scale < 75)
8. Patients at high risk of intra- and post-operative pulmonary complications (atelectasis, large pleural effusions)
9. Significant ascites with preoperative respiratory impact
10. Unbalanced diabetes (HbA1c > 8.5%)
11. Recent cerebral trauma < 6 months (of traumatic, ischemic or hemorrhagic origin)
12. Chronic kidney disease (estimated glomerular filtration rate < 30 mL/min/1.73m2 or need for renal replacement therapy)
13. Participation in another interventional research project or being in the exclusion period following a previous research project
14. Patient deprived of liberty
15. Patient under guardianship
16. Severe pre-operative Hypoalbuminemia (albuminemia < 20g/L)
17. Chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (left ventricular ejection fraction < 40%)
18. Allergy to exogen human albumin
19. Allergy to Ringer Lactate
